## Purpose and scope

This repo is setup as a template for Introduction to Data Science (HEIN11037).
It gives a minimum structure for students to contibute to a remote repo with some simple effort.

It is inteded as a space where students can add a file named for their student id (S number).
Students can gain practice with `qmd` files, introduce themselves to their cohort, or include a small code snippet.
Students can then clone and repo and render locally to learn about their peers.
It deliberatley avoids creaing a Pages site at this time. 

## Usage

In GitHub

- create a new repo for a new cohort, give it a namw (possible sourced from the students themselves)
- Select the option "Start with template", and search for `template-ids`
- Modify the README as appropriate for the new cohort
- Update the index with a list item for each student's id
